label: Your phone
note: A smartphone holds dozens of elements: lithium and cobalt in the battery, silicon chips, indium in the touchscreen, neodymium in the speakers.

label: Kitchen
note: Salt, foil, cast-iron pans, copper pots and even the water from the tap are all chemistry.

label: Your body
note: Just four elements, oxygen, carbon, hydrogen and nitrogen, make up about 96% of your body's mass.

label: Fireworks
note: Each color is an element's light fingerprint: strontium red, barium green, copper blue, sodium yellow.

label: Space & rockets
note: Hydrogen and oxygen fuel rockets, xenon pushes ion engines, plutonium powers rovers far from the Sun.

label: Hospital
note: MRI magnets cooled by helium, X-ray aprons made with lead, and radioactive tracers that light up organs.
